facts.text: Raffles Boston is at 40 Trinity Place in Boston's Back Bay neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Boston is conveniently situated at 40 Trinity Place

facts.text: The hotel is adjacent to the Boston Back Bay train station.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Boston is a 15-minute drive from Boston Logan International Airport and adjacent to the Boston Back Bay Train Station.

facts.text: The hotel is within a block of the high-end shopping at Copley Place.
facts.excerpt: it is within a block of high-end shopping at Copley Place

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Boston Public Library.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is conveniently located within walking distance to Boston's top attractions, including Boston Public Library

facts.text: Hospitality design firm Stonehill Taylor created all the rooms and suites and most of the public spaces.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning hospitality design firm Stonehill Taylor created all the rooms and suites and most of our public spaces

facts.text: The design draws on Boston's Emerald Necklace parks, with botanical influences throughout the property.
facts.excerpt: the city’s Emerald Necklace, carrying botanical influences throughout the property

facts.text: Copper accents throughout the hotel nod to Paul Revere's copper plating company.
facts.excerpt: Copper accents are prevalent throughout, in a nod to Paul Revere’s copper plating company

facts.text: Guest rooms reimagine mid-century American decor with woodgrain and warm brass.
facts.excerpt: Dramatic skies and city lights pair with woodgrain and warm brass to reimagine mid-century American decor in a thoroughly modern milieu.

facts.text: One sprawling suite has a living area with a fireplace and a baby grand piano.
facts.excerpt: A sprawling suite, panoramic views, living area with fireplace and baby grand piano.

facts.text: Long Bar and Terrace sits above Back Bay and is inspired by the Long Bar at Raffles Singapore, birthplace of the Singapore Sling.
facts.excerpt: Perched above Back Bay, Long Bar and Terrace blends Raffles heritage with Boston energy. Guests enjoy all-day dining, handcrafted cocktails, and sweeping skyline views. Inspired by the Long Bar at Raffles Singapore

facts.text: Long Bar and Terrace serves the Boston Sling, the hotel's gin-based take on the Singapore Sling with bright fruit and honeyed notes.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Boston’s interpretation featuring gin with bright fruit and honeyed notes

facts.text: Long Bar and Terrace serves New England classics such as lobster rolls and oysters on the half shell.
facts.excerpt: offering time-honoured New England classics such as lobster rolls and oysters on the half shell

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served at Long Bar and Terrace Thursday through Sunday.
facts.excerpt: alongside Afternoon Tea served Thursday through Sunday

facts.text: La Padrona serves refined Italian dishes.
facts.excerpt: refined Italian dishes at MICHELIN-recommended La Padrona

facts.text: La Padrona is MICHELIN-recommended.
facts.excerpt: refined Italian dishes at MICHELIN-recommended La Padrona

facts.text: The Blind Duck is a speakeasy-style cocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: craft cocktails at tHE Blind Duck, a speakeasy-style bar

facts.text: Cafe Pastel serves coffee and pastries for grab-and-go.
facts.excerpt: Café Pastel serves coffee and pastries, ideal for quick grab-and-go moments.

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Guests also enjoy 24-hour in-room dining for elevated private comfort.

facts.text: The hotel has a Guerlain Spa, an indoor lap pool, a hot tub and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: a full destination wellness experience at the Guerlain Spa, a 20-meter indoor lap pool, hot tub, and sauna

facts.text: The wellbeing floor is on the 4th floor and has four treatment rooms, a fitness center and an indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Our wellbeing sanctuary on the 4th floor features four treatment rooms, a state-of-the-art fitness center and sensational 20-meter indoor pool.

facts.text: Raffles Butlers help with unpacking, garment pressing, dining reservations and itineraries, and are available around the clock.
facts.excerpt: Dedicated butlers anticipate guest needs, from unpacking and garment pressing to dining reservations, bespoke itineraries, and in-room preferences. Available around the clock

facts.text: The Sky Gallery offers three full floors of flexible meeting and entertainment space.
facts.excerpt: our Sky Gallery offers three full floors of thoughtfully designed, flexible meeting and entertainment spaces for guests

facts.text: The ballroom is on the 19th floor, with views from Back Bay to Cambridge.
facts.excerpt: Set on the 19th floor, our unique space offers views spanning from Back Bay to Cambridge for elegant banquets.

facts.text: Pets are welcome for a fee per accommodation per stay; service animals are exempt.
facts.excerpt: A pet fee of $150 per accommodation, per stay applies, while service animals are graciously exempt.

facts.text: Electric vehicle transportation can be arranged on request.

facts.text: The Long Bar terrace views are weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: Weather permitting, the terrace offers sweeping views across Back Bay, making it especially popular at sunset.
